file_upload_prompts.label: Upload SOW, drawings, or prior daily reports

sections.label: Report Details
sections.instructions: Render ONLY a two-column markdown table of the report metadata: rows for Project, Job #, Location, Report Date, Day/Status, Prepared By — values from the user fields. No prose. This is the boxed identification block.

sections.label: Weather Conditions
sections.instructions: A markdown table with columns: Conditions | High Temp | Precipitation | Wind (one row). Then one short paragraph 'Impact on Work' from the user's weather input. Do not invent figures not provided.

sections.label: Crew
sections.instructions: A markdown table with columns: Name | Role | Hours | Cert, one row per crew member parsed from the crew field (pipe-delimited). Add a final 'Total Crew Hours' row summing Hours. Right-align Hours.

sections.label: Work Performed
sections.instructions: A markdown table with columns: Time | Activity, one row per time block from the work-performed field, in chronological order. Preserve the user's times and details exactly; do not embellish.

sections.label: Installation / Work Status
sections.instructions: A markdown table with columns: Area | Quantity | Status | Notes from the work-status field, plus a final TOTAL row. Right-align Quantity.

sections.label: Equipment On Site
sections.instructions: A tight bullet list, one item per line from the equipment field. Omit the section entirely if no equipment was provided.

sections.label: Materials Consumed
sections.instructions: A tight bullet list of materials from the materials field. Omit if none provided.

sections.label: Third-Party / Subcontractor Activity
sections.instructions: A tight bullet list of other parties on site. Omit if none provided.

sections.label: Issues, Delays, and Schedule Variance
sections.instructions: A tight bullet list. If none provided, render a single line: 'No issues, delays, or schedule variance.'

sections.label: Safety Observations
sections.instructions: A tight bullet list of safety observations from the field. Omit if none provided.

sections.label: Report Prepared and Submitted By
sections.instructions: Render the preparer block: name, title, and credentials from prepared_by, each on its own line, followed by a line 'Signature & Date'. No table.
